interface: Interdigitated traces read resistively via pull-up into SIM4 ADC; excitation duty-cycled in firmware to prevent electrolysis

measurands.name: wet
measurands.accuracy: binary event; threshold set on raw_mv

measurands.name: raw_mv
measurands.accuracy: dry reads near pull-up rail, wet reads low

liveness: expected silent for months; watchdog verifies seq heartbeat weekly; wet=0 from a dead sensor and from a dry floor are indistinguishable without it
failure_modes: gradual raw_mv drift downward while dry: dust/condensation film accumulating, clean the traces
stuck wet after the floor dried: residue bridging traces
no frames at all: dead SIM, not a dry floor; liveness check is the only defence
mounting: flat on the lowest point of the protected floor, traces up, cable strain-relieved
packaged_dimensions_mm: approximately 30 x 10 mm sensing area [PLACEHOLDER: confirm production PCB]
